title: Thin-Lens Focal Length
prompt: An object 2 m from a thin lens forms an image 3 m away. Using 1/f = 1/u + 1/v, find the focal length f (m) as an exact fraction.
recap: The thin-lens equation 1/f = 1/u + 1/v links object distance u, image distance v, and focal length f. Add the reciprocals, then invert for f.
